summary.text: Eric Murphy is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 43 (home city listed as Grand Forks), serving since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Murphy lists an occupation of Owner, Krampade, CamBioGene; Faculty, UND.
It lists education as BA, Biology/History, Hastings College; PhD, Biochemistry/Neurochemistry, Ohio State University.

It also lists Fellow, American Oil Chemists Society, American Society for Neurochemistry, International Society for Neurochemistry, Emeritus Editor in Chief, Lipids and Board, Research Institute for Autonomous Systems, UND.
Family is listed as: Married (Cindy); 3 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Murphy's standing committee assignments as Appropriations and Appropriations - Human Resources Division.
